gloss: to finish, to get done, to settle

definitions.explanation: To deal with or settle a matter.

examples.japanese: {食事|しょくじ}を{済|す}ませてから{行|い}く。
examples.english: I'll go after finishing the meal.

examples.japanese: {買|か}い{物|もの}を{済|す}ませた。
お{金|かね}で{済|す}ませる。
{出|で}かける{前|まえ}に{準備|じゅんび}を{全部|ぜんぶ}{済|す}ませた。
examples.english: I finished all the preparations before going out.

examples.japanese: {謝|あやま}るだけで{済|す}ませようとしている。
examples.english: They're trying to settle it with just an apology.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}が{始|はじ}まる{前|まえ}に{昼食|ちゅうしょく}を{済|す}ませておきたい。
examples.english: I want to finish lunch before the meeting starts.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{忙|いそが}しいから、{昼|ひる}ごはんはコンビニで{済|す}ませた。
examples.english: I was busy today, so I just grabbed something at a convenience store for lunch.

examples.japanese: {面倒|めんどう}なことはメールで{済|す}ませないで、{直接|ちょくせつ}{会|あ}って{話|はな}したほうがいい。
examples.english: For troublesome matters, it's better to meet and talk in person rather than settling it by email.

notes:
{済|す}ませる means to finish, complete, or settle something. It emphasizes getting something done or out of the way.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pair: {済|す}む (intransitive - to be finished/done)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Xを{済|す}ませる: to finish X
- Xで{済|す}ませる: to settle with X, to manage with just X
- {先|さき}に{済|す}ませる: to get done first
- {早|はや}く{済|す}ませる: to finish quickly

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仕事|しごと}を{済|す}ませる: to finish work
- {食事|しょくじ}を{済|す}ませる: to finish a meal
- {用事|ようじ}を{済|す}ませる: to finish errands
- {手続|てつづ}きを{済|す}ませる: to complete procedures

SIMILAR VERBS:
- {終|お}える: to finish, complete (neutral)
- {済|す}ませる: to get done, settle (emphasis on disposing of)
- {片付|かたづ}ける: to tidy up, finish off
